ruled_out.cls: well-network laws with no continuum limit
ruled_out.basis: 390 of 3,123 settings have NO continuum limit at all: the response depends on how a cataloguer deblended the image. Gate 3, decidable before any data.

ruled_out.cls: bounded-response laws as an explanation of flat curves
ruled_out.basis: a bounded K can only renormalise G; the sharpened form is that EVERY available invariant decays outward, so no member of the family produces a flat curve at any amplitude.

ruled_out.cls: pair/graph laws with p = 0 mass weighting
ruled_out.basis: selective refinement measures d ln(W1/W2)/d ln N = +1.000 against an admissible 0 -- how finely a DIFFERENT object is tabulated sets the field near an untouched one.

ruled_out.cls: tensor laws whose only signature is the transverse eigenvalue
ruled_out.basis: for spherical rho, Phi depends on k_r alone. The transverse eigenvalue is unobservable, so such a law is untestable in principle on a spherical source, not merely unmeasured.

ruled_out.cls: the field-direction projector as a tensor mechanism
ruled_out.basis: (g^ g^T) grad Phi_N = grad Phi_N exactly -- the projector IS the identity, so the mechanism is empty.
1,504 DES supernovae give b = 1.003 +- 0.011 in dt_obs = dt_em (1+z)^b. An eta = 0 mechanism carrying all of z predicts b = 0: excluded at 90 SIGMA. Survives only at f < 1.9%.

ruled_out.cls: Newtonian gravity on baryons alone as a structure-formation law
ruled_out.basis: linear growth amplification 11.8 against the ~1e5 required -- short by 3-4 orders at every scale tested.

ruled_out.cls: the tidal-gated scalar as an EXTERNAL/environmental law
ruled_out.basis: on a spherical source |T~| = sqrt(6)(g/r)|1 - rho/<rho>| identically, so the gate reads g/r, a LOCAL kinematic ratio. The 151x member-vs-shell ordering is g/r at two radii.

ruled_out.cls: the tidal gate as an improvement to cluster lensing
ruled_out.basis: on 3,365 raw eFEDS/DECADE shear points both tidal variants fit WORSE than predicting no lensing signal at all (chi2 4472.9 and 5998.2 against 3865.0), and both require eta < 0 -- light bending the wrong way relative to matter.

ruled_out.cls: pressure / amplified-stress as the cluster source term
ruled_out.basis: the exact forward chain over-predicts at -13.0 sigma with all 40 LoCuSS clusters over-predicted, and the amplitude and temperature-shape channels demand mutually exclusive couplings.

ruled_out.cls: the nonlocal path kernel as a rotation-curve law
ruled_out.basis: Phi = -GMF/r is exact outside a source and qbar in [0,1) bounds F, so asymptotically flat curves are impossible for the family; on the same footing it scores 0.256/0.209 dex against the RAR's 0.121/0.122.

ruled_out.cls: [withdrawn] the cluster excess organised by r/R500
ruled_out.basis: CLASH's numerator and x-axis are two functionals of ONE two-parameter NFW fit; 83-85% of the slope is template with no noise at all. r/R500 and r are the same regressor given per-cluster levels. NOT an admissible elimination or finding.

ruled_out.cls: [detector statement] tensor and network detectors as evidence for directional gravity
ruled_out.basis: family-wise false-positive rate on a DARK MATTER universe is 0.648 [0.604, 0.689]. A triaxial collisionless halo misaligned from the baryons IS the tensor signature. This rules out the DETECTORS, not the physics.

the network detector moves 0.0003 across the whole amplitude range -- 2.3% of its own critical value, power 0.000. U6 is found only through its monopole. The premise is undetectable by the instrument built for it.
